card.name: No clinical studies establishing evidence
card.fires_on: The word "establishing" in the phrase "no clinical studies establishing", mostly in the Macrovascular Outcomes warning for diabetes drugs. Weaker on a few stray words nearby.

modes.label: Studies establishing evidence
modes.description: The word "establishing" right after "no clinical studies", before conclusive evidence or benefits.

modes.description: Occasional words such as "of" after "conclusive evidence", or "See" before "also".
